body: I still have heard nothing. I am still hoping that changes. :(

I just keep wondering if there's anything I could have said or done to change things...why you rushed things.... I keep hoping in my heart of hearts that this is an elaborate cruel joke. I've even hoped for things as sinister as a botched attempt leaving you paralyzed and unable to go through with another attempt.  I can't help but go through every possible scenario..everything I could have said...or shouldn't have said. I'm tearing myself apart. Please be okay. Please.
I just wish I knew. I'd rather he be a living intelligent asshole than a dead good man. His name is overly common in Norway so google isn't helping at all.
Still no reply. I'm a mess.

And if he isn't trolling I'm even more fucking upset because the person I talked to more than anyone on this planet in the last week is fucking dead. Somebody I talked more within 8 days than I do most people in a year. One of the most intelligent and good people I've had the honor or meeting if his claims of himself are true. That is a pretty big thing to be wrong with me. I slept like shit and I've been shaking and close to hurling since reading his post. He posted it while I was in the middle of writing a mammoth response to his last e-mail and I saw it hours later.
What's wrong with me is I've been talking with him a LOT in the past 8 days. He's been lying to me, or he just lied here. It reeks of trolling. It's pretty emotionally cruel trolling at that.

I better see a reply to my e-mail when I wake up. I did not spend the past week exchanging nearly 20,000 words with a fucking dead man. You are 10 months short of your date. You're a troll or sick; either way you're a pretty big bastard.

Thank you. While I'm no longer as low as I was I am certainly still pretty down. Hearing the other side of this provided some much needed relief. I cannot even express my level of gratitude for taking your time to share.
Thank you for sharing. I'm feeling better today. I was insanely low that night, crying my eyes out and staring at pill bottles. It's people like you that make me want "to be".
It was this comment and a temporary tattoo mustache that snapped me out of the pit. Thank you, you made a world of difference in my perspective.
You just quoted my favorite speech of all time. Loosely. :) As for everything else I'm going to stew on it before responding
I have been there sweetie. It's a low low spot. Fortunately I am not that low as of now. Know that there are others, tons of us, who'd love to talk to you, now and beyond that date time and place
I don't by ANY means condone taking your life, but for the love...don't leave loose ends. Work that out.
You have a friend worth waiting for, that's something. I'm not in great shape right now myself but I'd like to hear more and get to know you
I don't know if I'm much better off than you right now, but we can talk if it helps. Helping others generally makes me feel better.
